7 Brew Cinnamon Roll Breve: Price, Calories & Recipe

A medium Cinnamon Roll Breve is about $5.25, with 510 calories, 120 mg of caffeine and 47 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Is there a sugar-free Cinnamon Roll Breve?

Yes — 7 Brew lists a sugar-free version built with sugar-free syrups. Comparing mediums (iced):

VersionCaloriesSugarCarbsCaffeine
Cinnamon Roll Breve50047 g52 g120 mg
Sugar-free Cinnamon Roll Breve4006 g28 g120 mg

Caffeine does not change — only the syrup does. See every sugar-free option in the customization guide.

Every sugar-free swap on the menu, compared side by side, lives on our sugar-free drinks page.

Cinnamon Roll Breve allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Milk for the Cinnamon Roll Breve. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Cinnamon Roll Breve

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Cinnamon Roll Breve?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Cinnamon Roll at Home (Copycat Recipe)

Most fan pages guess at this one. These are the stand's own measurements, shared by brewistas and corrected by a second one: the cinnamon roll flavor is equal parts white chocolate sauce and brown sugar cinnamon syrup, one scoop is 1 oz, and a medium takes 2 scoops total.

For one medium iced Cinnamon Roll (24 oz cup)

  • 2 shots of espresso (about 2 oz), hot
  • 1 oz white chocolate sauce
  • 1 oz brown sugar cinnamon syrup
  • About 8 oz half-and-half
  • A full cup of ice
  1. Pour the white chocolate sauce and brown sugar cinnamon syrup into the cup.
  2. Add the hot espresso and stir. The heat melts the sauce so the cinnamon spreads evenly.
  3. Fill the cup with ice, then pour the half-and-half over the top.
  4. Stir once and drink.

Hot version: steam the half-and-half, skip the ice, same sauces and shots. Sugar-free version: swap both for sugar-free versions. At the stand, the sugar-free medium runs 400 calories with 6 g of sugar, going by the official guide. Extra sweet, the fan way: 1.5 oz of each flavor plus 1.5 oz toasted marshmallow syrup, and drop the half-and-half to about 7 oz. No espresso machine? Use 2 oz of very strong coffee.

7 Brew Cinnamon Roll Breve FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Cinnamon Roll Breve?

A medium iced Cinnamon Roll Breve has 510 calories. A small has 290 and a large 590, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Cinnamon Roll Breve?

About 120 mg in a medium. Small is 120 mg and large is 240 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew Cinnamon Roll Breve cost?

Roughly $4.50 for a small, $5.25 for a medium and $6.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Cinnamon Roll Breve?

47 g in a medium, or 6 g if you order the sugar-free version.

What is in a 7 Brew Cinnamon Roll Breve?

Equal parts white chocolate sauce and brown sugar cinnamon syrup, espresso, and a half-and-half breve base. The official menu line says it plainly: Brown Sugar Cinnamon + White Chocolate Breve. No vanilla, despite what some fan pages list.

Can I order the Cinnamon Roll as a latte?

Yes. The default build is a breve (half-and-half), but the cinnamon roll part is just the two flavors, so you can order them in a latte, a mocha, or even a chai. Fans commonly order it as a latte for a lighter, milkier cup.

How many calories are in the sugar-free Cinnamon Roll?

A sugar-free medium iced has 400 calories and 6 g of sugar, against 510 calories and 47 g in the regular. This is one of the Originals where sugar-free really does cut calories too, by 110.

What is a Cinnamon Roll Blondie at 7 Brew?

A mash-up of two Originals: the Cinnamon Roll flavors (white chocolate and brown sugar cinnamon) plus the Blondie's caramel and vanilla, in the same breve base. Order it by asking for a Blondie with cinnamon roll flavors added, or a Cinnamon Roll with caramel and vanilla.

How do I make a 7 Brew Cinnamon Roll at home?

For a medium iced: 1 oz white chocolate sauce and 1 oz brown sugar cinnamon syrup, 2 shots of espresso, and about 8 oz of half-and-half over ice. Those are the stand's own scoop measurements. The full copycat recipe is in the recipe section on this page.
